decisions.title: Retain retired dialectic choreography as attic docs or delete it
decisions.option_a: Move `skills/design/references/dialectic-legacy.md` to `docs/attic/dialectic-legacy.md` and repoint the audit-use note.
decisions.option_b: Delete `skills/design/references/dialectic-legacy.md` and remove the audit-use note, relying on git history for archaeology.
decisions.tradeoff: Option A preserves a readable audit artifact outside the runtime reference tree but keeps hundreds of lines in the repo. Option B maximizes cleanup but makes old Step 2a.5 behavior harder to inspect without git archaeology.
decisions.why_this_matters: The file header explicitly names audit consumers, so deletion versus attic retention is a real product-maintenance choice rather than a naming preference.
